title: "append_allele_annotations"

This is a script to append ClinVar annotations and gnomAD allele frequencies to our allele collection.

Load necessary packages
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
# install.packages("downloader")  # Install if not already installed
library(downloader)
```

Download & format the ClinVar variant summary file
```{r}
# Download the latest ClinVar variant summary file
url <- "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/tab_delimited/variant_summary.txt.gz"
destfile <- "inputs/clinvar_variant_summary.txt.gz"
download.file(url, destfile, mode = "wb")

# Read in the file
clinvar = read.delim(gzfile("inputs/clinvar_variant_summary.txt.gz"))

# Filter & format columns
clinvar = data.table(
  separate(clinvar, 
           Name, 
           into = c("NM", "version", "gene","c","clinvar_nt_change","p","clinvar_aa_change"), 
           sep = "[().]")) %>%
  filter(Assembly == "GRCh38") %>%
  mutate(SPDI = paste0(ChromosomeAccession,":",
                       PositionVCF,":",
                       ReferenceAlleleVCF,":",
                       AlternateAlleleVCF),
         RefSeq_mRNA = paste0(NM,".", version),
         across(where(is.character), str_trim),
         StarStatus = case_when(grepl("single|conflicting", ReviewStatus) ~ 1,
                                grepl("multiple", ReviewStatus) ~ 2,
                                grepl("expert", ReviewStatus) ~ 3,
                                grepl("practice", ReviewStatus) ~ 4)) %>%
  select(-c(NM, version, gene, c, p, ReferenceAllele, AlternateAllele))

```

Define functions
```{r}
# Function to append ClinVar annotations to the allele set according to SPDI
append_clinvar = function(file) {
  # read in allele set file
  dt = fread(file)
  
  # append clinvar annotations & rename columns
  dt = merge(dt, clinvar, by.x = "spdi", by.y = "SPDI", all.x = T) %>%
    rename(ccsb_nt_change = nt_change,
           ccsb_aa_change = aa_change)
  
  # report how many alleles did not map to clinvar
  report <<- paste0(nrow(dt[!spdi == "NULL" & is.na(X.AlleleID)][!duplicated(spdi)]),
                  " alleles out of ",
                  nrow(dt[!spdi == "NULL"][!duplicated(spdi)]),
                  " didn't map to ClinVar")
  
  # return appended table
  return(dt)
}

# Function to write the input file of variants to query in gnomAD
listVar = function(dt, name) {
  variants = data.table(CHROM = paste0("chr",dt[grepl(">", ccsb_nt_change)]$chr),
                        POS = dt[grepl(">", ccsb_nt_change)]$chr_pos_38,
                        REF = sub(".*([A-Z])>.*", "\\1", 
                                  dt[grepl(">", ccsb_nt_change)]$ccsb_nt_change),
                        ALT = sub(".*>([A-Z]).*", "\\1", 
                                  dt[grepl(">", ccsb_nt_change)]$ccsb_nt_change))
  write.table(variants, paste0("outputs/", name, "_variants_list.txt"), 
              row.names=FALSE, sep="\t", quote = F, col.names = F)
}

# Function to append allele frequencies to data table - processing gnomAD output
append_gnomAD = function(dt, dir) {
  # read in variant allele frequencies across all chromosomes
  af = rbindlist(
    lapply(list.files(dir, pattern = "chr.*_allele_frequencies.txt", full.names = TRUE), fread)
    )
  af[, varid := paste0(gsub("chr","",V1), "-",V2,"-",V3,"-",V4)]
  setkey(af, varid)

  # append allele frequencies
  dt[, varid := paste0(chr,"-",
                       chr_pos_38,"-",
                       sub(".*([A-Z])>.*", "\\1", ccsb_nt_change),"-",
                       sub(".*>([A-Z]).*", "\\1", ccsb_nt_change))]
  dt[!is.na(varid), gnomad_af := af[varid]$V5]
  return(dt)
}

```

Execute functions pt.1
  USER DEFINED VARIABLES - specify pathways
```{r}
# Append ClinVar annotations for the One Percent data set
one = append_clinvar(file = "inputs/VarChamp_1_percent_variants.tsv")
# Report how many alleles are missing ClinVar annotations
print(report)
# Generate input file for querying gnomAD
listVar(dt = one, name = "onepercent")

# Append ClinVar annotations for the Consolidated data set
cons = append_clinvar(file = "inputs/VarChamp_Consolidated_allele_collection.tsv")
# Report how many alleles are missing ClinVar annotations
print(report)
# Generate input file for querying gnomAD
listVar(dt = cons, name = "consolidated") 

```


PAUSE HERE: run 'extract_gnomad_af.sh' script using the "name_variants_list.txt" file output from the listVar function. Outputs from 'extract_gnomad_af.sh' are then used to append allele frequencies to your data set.

Execute functions pt.2
  USER DEFINED VARIABLES - specify pathways
```{r}
# Append allele frequencies to One Percent data set
gnom_one = append_gnomAD(dt = one, dir = "outputs/gnomad_af/onepercent/") 
# Save final output
fwrite(gnom_one, "outputs/onepercent_ClinVar_output.csv")

# Append allele frequencies to Consolidated data set
gnom_cons = append_gnomAD(dt = cons, dir = "outputs/gnomad_af/consolidated/") 
# Save final output
fwrite(gnom_cons, "outputs/consolidated_ClinVar_output.csv")
```
